color.$description: Sportsbook color primitives — a fixed, theme-editor-driven set, NOT a generative Tailwind ramp. Baked here to the 'Pro layout' theme; in the live product these are CSS variables the in-app Theme Editor rewrites at runtime (that is why there are no 25→950 steps — the ramp concept does not exist here). base = surfaces + text + active/accent, all editable in the Theme Editor. status = win/lose/warning (editable) + 4 extra bet-status hues, color-4..7, that the Theme Editor ignores and are set only via an imported theme file. sub = opacity-derived washes: colored 12% tints, black darken/shadow steps (built on the PAGE color surface-0, not pure black), and white lighten steps.

surface-0.$description: Main background — the page. Darkest surface, everything else sits on top. Theme Editor: 'Surfaces → Main background'.

surface-2.$description: Cards & popups — the first elevation above the page. Theme Editor: 'Surfaces → Cards & popups'.

surface-4.$description: Sub elements — filled inputs, secondary/sub buttons, chips. Theme Editor: 'Surfaces → Sub elements'.

surface-6.$description: Borders, hairlines, outline-button borders, hover fills. A fill/outline color, NOT a page background — use as a background only for genuine exceptions (e.g. the score chip). Theme Editor: 'Surfaces → Borders & hover'.

secondary.$description: Secondary text & icons — the one muted grey (there is no separate 'muted' step; secondary covers both). Theme Editor: 'Text → Secondary text'.

contrast.$description: Primary text & icons — maximum contrast on the dark surfaces. Theme Editor: 'Text → Primary text'.

active-1.$description: Active color — flat usage (text, icons, borders) AND the gradient START. Theme Editor: 'Active elements → Text, borders, icons' / gradient start.

active-2.$description: Active gradient END. Split from active-1 only because Figma cannot store a gradient in one variable; equal to active-1 when the theme has no gradient (as in Pro). Theme Editor: 'Active elements → gradient end'.

accent.$description: Secondary accent / brand pop — distinct from the active color (in Pro: active is orange, accent is blue). Theme Editor: 'Brand & accent → Secondary accent'.

positive.$description: Win / positive / gains. Editable in the Theme Editor ('Brand & accent → Positive').

negative.$description: Lose / negative / errors. Editable in the Theme Editor ('Brand & accent → Negative').

warning.$description: Warning / cashout / needs-attention. Editable in the Theme Editor ('Brand & accent → Warning').

color-4.$description: Extra bet-status hue (Pro: teal). Meaning is assigned at the semantic layer (half-win). Theme Editor ignores it — set only via an imported theme file.

color-5.$description: Extra bet-status hue (Pro: orange). Semantic meaning: half-lose. File-only, not in the Theme Editor.

color-6.$description: Extra bet-status hue (Pro: purple). Semantic meaning: refund. File-only, not in the Theme Editor.

color-7.$description: Extra bet-status hue (Pro: grey). Semantic meaning: pending. File-only, not in the Theme Editor.

white.$description: Pure white — theme-independent. Base for the sub.white-* lighten steps.

black.$description: Pure black — theme-independent. NB: the darken/shadow steps use surface-0 (the page color), NOT this, so hover/shadow reads as 'toward the page' rather than muddy true-black.

active-2.$description: active-2 @ 12% — active tint wash. Freebet label, selected/active background.

accent-2.$description: accent @ 12% — accent tint wash. Live label.

black-2.$description: surface-0 (page color) @ 12% — darken/shadow step 1. Overlay for pressed states & the softest shadow.

black-6.$description: page color @ 50% — darken/shadow step 3, also the modal/drawer scrim.

black-8.$description: page color @ 80% — darken/shadow step 4, the heaviest.

white-2.$description: white @ 12% — lighten step 1. Hover overlay on dark surfaces, inactive counter background.
